semiconductor_relevance: High — Brno University of Technology is actively involved in chip design and semiconductor technologies through research and education.
summary: Brno University of Technology provides educational and research services in semiconductor technologies, focusing on the design and verification of custom integrated circuits. They operate the largest academic clean room facility in Czechia, supporting both academic and industry projects in semiconductor development.
capabilities: Design and verification of custom integrated circuits (analog, digital, mixed-mode)
